used.description: When a person or their app last used this entity.

changed.description: When a write last changed this app's store, to the hour; an install or a schema move is no change.

errored.description: When this app's code last reported an error, to the hour.

translated.description: A retired query spelling an app still sends, which the grammar translates, and the hour it last did.
translated.$comment: An app whose code still sends a query in a retired spelling, which the grammar translates for kept releases (T-122930). A translation goes only once no app has sent its spelling for a while (T-123000, M-37853).
